name: nginx-healthz-404
about: nginx has no /healthz; the probe gets 404
events: 5s Warning Unhealthy pod/web Readiness probe failed: HTTP probe failed with statuscode: 404
web:
Title: Kubernetes readiness probe returns 404 on nginx
The stock nginx image serves / and /index.html. There is no /healthz route unless you add one, so point the readiness probe at / or add a location block.

name: httpd-health-404
events: 8s Warning Unhealthy pod/site Readiness probe failed: HTTP probe failed with statuscode: 404
web:
Title: httpd container never becomes ready
The official httpd image only serves htdocs (index.html at /). Probes on /health fail with 404; use / as the readiness path.

Title: connection refused in readiness probe
The container is not listening on the probed port. Check containerPort and the probe port.

Title: Fixing readiness probe failures
In our experience readiness failures are almost always memory pressure. Raising the memory limit to 4Gi fixed it for us.

name: slow-start-timeout
about: the probe path is right, the app is just slow: changing the path would be wrong
events: 4s Warning Unhealthy pod/api Readiness probe failed: Get "http://10.42.0.7:8080/ready": context deadline exceeded (Client.Timeout exceeded while awaiting headers)
web:
Title: readiness probe context deadline exceeded
The app answers too slowly. Raise timeoutSeconds / initialDelaySeconds or add a startupProbe.
